data.subject: Boston Red Sox staff and front office

reports.text: The worst-kept secret at the GM Meetings is that the Red Sox are shopping Jaren Duran (a year too late, but nonetheless). Sox have also inquired about free agent Seiya Suzuki to add to a lineup that finished 12th in the AL in home runs last season
Confirming reports that Kyle Hudson, former Red Sox third base coach, has been hired by the Tigers as their new first base coach for 2027, replacing Anthony Sanders.
The Boston Red Sox are hiring Astros quality control coach Jason Bell onto their major-league coaching staff, sources tell @theathletic.com
